title: World Organisation of the Scout Movement
description: The World Organisation of the Scout Movement uses a multi-color youth-movement palette including orange (#ff912a), teal (#205b41), cyan (#088486), bright purple (#7413dc), white (#ffffff), black (#000000), bright red (#ed3f23), light pink (#ffb4e5), green (#25b755), blue (#003982), bright blue (#006ddf), and amber (#ffe627).
